svg.title: RES-495 bench press: support reactions and bar height
svg.desc: Bench reaction (purple), summed foot force (green) and rack-hook reaction (orange) over system weight, and bar height change from setup (blue, metres), with chest-touch markers.
svg.text: RES-495 bench press: support reactions and bar height
Synthetic only. Feet-only plates are incomplete: most of the supine lifter's weight is on the bench.
